title: What if you bet £1,000 on Leicester? (cartoon story)

scenes.text: What if you bet £1,000 on Leicester City to win the Premier League? Stay until the end.
August 2015. He walks into the bookies and puts £1,000 on Leicester. The odds? 5000 to 1.
His mates can't stop laughing. Leicester almost got relegated last season!
But he just smiles. He knows something they don't.
The new manager? Claudio Ranieri. Even Gary Lineker tweets: Claudio Ranieri? Really?
Then Jamie Vardy starts scoring. And scoring. 11 games in a row. A new Premier League record.
Christmas 2015. Leicester are top of the league. His mates stop laughing.
February. Leicester smash Manchester City 3-1. Away from home.
Then his phone rings. The bookies want to buy back his bet. His mates beg him to take the money. He says no.
May 2016. If Tottenham don't win at Chelsea, Leicester are champions. Chelsea 2. Tottenham 2.
Leicester City are champions of England!
So how much does he win? £1,000 at 5000 to 1... 5 million pounds.
What would you do with 5 million? Follow for more What Ifs.
